research_recommendation: Use 25 MW total facility input as an expandable planning envelope; investigate a 12 MW contracted first phase in 2030 and 15 MW in 2033 for the 70 percent controlled colo annual workload share. The remaining 30 percent is an eligible external cloud annual share, not a measured temporal peak. Compare against public-price cloud and retain 20-25 MW as an uncommitted expansion option.
